signal: Olo went private in a $2B sale to Thoma Bravo in 2025, acquired loyalty platform Spendgo, and is launching the Olo App and commission-free Olo Network in late 2026.

email.body1:
Michael, saw Olo go private with Thoma Bravo and line up the Olo App and Olo Network for late 2026.

A pivot that big usually means more enterprise restaurant brands are worth a conversation than any seller can personally cover, and good accounts go quiet before a rep follows up. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Olo off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for Olo.

Under new ownership with a new network launching, pipeline expectations usually rise faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many enterprise meetings Olo needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for Olo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Olo's reply rate likely compares to other restaurant-tech platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A take-private plus a network launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise restaurant-tech motion? I will tailor it to Olo either way.
